button.$description: Corner radius of the button (BR-10, REQ-023 AC2). Uses the `interactive` radius role, the `radius.md` step (ADR-0050, TBD-10).
Outline stroke width of the button (BR-10, REQ-023 AC2).
Neon glow of the button at rest, the pink one (BR-10, REQ-023 AC2, ADR-0051). Each variant reads its own glow below. A disabled button shows no glow (REQ-023 AC5).

color.$description: Focus ring color of the button (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of the button (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between the button and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of the button (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

bg.$description: Fill of the primary button: brand pink (BR-01, BR-11).

bgHover.$description: Fill of the primary button while hovered: the lighter pink tone (ADR-0055).

bgActive.$description: Fill of the primary button while pressed: the darker pink tone (ADR-0055).

fg.$description: Label of the primary button: black on the pink fill (SPEC.md section 2.1, REQ-023 AC3).

border.$description: Outline color of the primary button: brand pink (BR-01, BR-10).

glow.$description: Neon glow of the primary button at rest: pink, 12 px blur, 1 px spread, 60% opacity (ADR-0051).

glowHover.$description: Neon glow of the primary button while hovered or pressed: pink, 20 px blur, 2 px spread, 85% opacity (ADR-0051).

bg.$description: Fill of the secondary button: brand yellow (BR-02, BR-11).

bgHover.$description: Fill of the secondary button while hovered: the lighter yellow tone (ADR-0055). It is close to the rest yellow, so the glow carries the hover state.

bgActive.$description: Fill of the secondary button while pressed: the darker yellow tone (ADR-0055).

fg.$description: Label of the secondary button: black on the yellow fill (SPEC.md section 2.1).

border.$description: Outline color of the secondary button: brand yellow (BR-02, BR-10).

glow.$description: Neon glow of the secondary button at rest: yellow, 12 px blur, 1 px spread, 60% opacity (ADR-0051).

glowHover.$description: Neon glow of the secondary button while hovered or pressed: yellow, 20 px blur, 2 px spread, 85% opacity (ADR-0051).

fg.$description: Label of the ghost button: brand pink on the page (BR-01, BR-11).

fgHover.$description: Label of the ghost button while hovered: brand pink on the black page. The ghost button hovers with the glow only (ADR-0055).

bgHover.$description: Fill of the ghost button while hovered: the black page. The ghost button hovers with the glow only (ADR-0055).

bgActive.$description: Fill of the ghost button while pressed: the darker pink tone (ADR-0055). Proposed by T13.2: ADR-0055 decides the ghost hover only.

border.$description: Outline color of the ghost button: brand pink (BR-01, BR-10).

glow.$description: Neon glow of the ghost button at rest: pink, 12 px blur, 1 px spread, 60% opacity (ADR-0051).

glowHover.$description: Neon glow of the ghost button while hovered or pressed: pink, 20 px blur, 2 px spread, 85% opacity (ADR-0051).

fgActive.$description: Label of the ghost button while pressed: black on the darker pink fill (SPEC.md section 2.1).
